frontMatter.title: The Wait is Almost Over: New Season Starts Soon!
frontMatter.summary: Get ready for a brand new season with exciting games, team selections, and plenty of fun. Join us on 3rd September for the start of an exciting journey!

prev.title: Navan Badminton Club 2025 AGM
prev.summary: Join us for the 2025 Annual General Meeting (AGM) of Navan Badminton Club on Wednesday, 13th August at 8 PM in Claremont Stadium. Your participation and input are highly valued.

next.summary: Join us for Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium. Courts are ready, new members are welcome, and fun is guaranteed!
